description: The sample inputs of the RFC 8785 reference test data and their canonical forms.

cases.description: Arrays keep their order; member names sort as strings, so "10" sorts before "d" and after "1".
Member names sort by UTF-16 code units, not by locale.

output.value: {"peach":"This sorting order","péché":"is wrong according to French","pêche":"but canonicalization MUST","sin":"ignore locale"}

cases.description: Nested objects sort recursively; an empty name sorts first; 56.0 is written 56.
Strings are not normalized: A followed by U+030A stays two code points.
Numbers use the shortest round-trip form; strings escape only what JSON requires.
Escaped and literal names sort by their UTF-16 code units; U+0080, U+007F and </script> are literal.

  "</script>": "Browser Challenge"
}
